tasks.short: Diagnose and treat hearing or related disabilities under the direction of an audiologist.

steps.what: Diagnose hearing disabilities from the test in the room
Take direction from the audiologist on that diagnosis
treat related disabilities under that direction

tasks.design: She diagnoses the hearing disability with the customer in the room, takes direction from the audiologist, and treats that customer herself. No second hearing note is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The disability is judged with the customer present, and the audiologist gives direction in that visit.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the diagnosis or the treatment. Imaging checks, prescription surveillance and consultation summaries in the digest are other occupations. She still judges the disability in the room. Medical-purpose software is a device, and this visit does not add one.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to judge which disability fits and carry out the treatment on that customer.
tasks.human_edge: Only she hears the customer and treats under the audiologist who directs that case.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still diagnoses in the room, still takes the audiologist's direction, and still treats.

reach.task: Give direction before she treats the disability
reach.learn: Which hearing disability she diagnosed in the room

evidence.claim: Diagnosing and treating a hearing disability in the room, under an audiologist's direction, stays with the hearing aid specialist.

assumptions: The visit starts when the customer is in the room and ends when she has treated under the audiologist's direction.
No structured field is added. There is no producer and no extraction fallback.
She diagnoses and treats in the room. That time stays.
No second hearing note is named in this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: Whether the audiologist writes the hearing note after she has treated.
research_questions: Does she record the diagnosis during the visit, or does the audiologist write it afterwards?

already_counted.description: She still diagnoses, takes direction, and treats.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A diagnosis the audiologist already made is not her time. She still diagnoses, takes direction, and treats. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Diagnosis and treatment stay her week. She gains no right to treat a hearing disability without the audiologist's direction.
skills_to_grow: Stop when the hearing test does not match the complaint the customer described.
Say which related disability the treatment does not cover.
Wait for the audiologist's direction before treating.
role.ambitious_version: She still diagnoses in the room, still takes the audiologist's direction, and still treats that customer. No remote diagnosis.
